entities.summary:
Netflix is an American subscription video on-demand over-the-top streaming service that primarily distributes original and acquired films and television shows from various genres.

Founded in 1997 by Reed Hastings and Marc Randolph in California, USA, the company began as a DVD rental service but shifted its focus to streaming in 2007.

The rise of Netflix can be attributed to several factors, including the increasing popularity of online streaming, the proliferation of high-speed internet, and the growing demand for original content.

One of the key events that led to Netflix's success was the launch of its popular original series 'House of Cards' in 2013, which received widespread critical acclaim and helped establish the platform as a major player in the entertainment industry.

As a result, Netflix has had a profound impact on the entertainment industry, changing the way people consume media and creating new opportunities for creators and producers.

This legacy can be seen in the proliferation of streaming services across the globe, the increase in original content production, and the rise of new business models in the entertainment industry.

The significance of Netflix in the history of the entertainment industry cannot be overstated, as it has revolutionized the way we consume media and has had a profound impact on the global economy.

In conclusion, Netflix's rise to prominence was a result of a combination of technological advancements, changing consumer behavior, and a strategic shift in business model.

This is evident in the way Netflix has continued to innovate and expand its services, embracing new technologies and formats to stay ahead of the curve.

The impact of Netflix on the entertainment industry has been profound, and its legacy will continue to shape the industry for years to come.
